title: Integer displacement of the decoded inverse move
statement: For every head move $d\in\{-1,0,1\}$, the integer displacement of the inverse move obtained by encoding $d$ as a tape symbol and then decoding that symbol is the negative of the integer displacement of $d$.
replaced:
For every head move $d$, encoding $d$ as a tape symbol and decoding the inverse
move yields exactly the negation of $d$'s integer head displacement.
